format: sprite scale = CHARACTER[id].height * pixelsToLogicalBody; origin = anchorPixels / cellSize. scaleCorrection also multiplies existing scale. Uniform scale only.
measurementBasis: Compare forehead-to-chin, shoulder-to-belt and straight limb segments to locomotion frame6 at equal runtime height, excluding hair, sword, effects. Values are visual estimates from saved contact sheets, not landmark-certified 5-percent accuracy.
